---
title: ylab
subtitle: Shortcut for setting the y axis title.
category: Labs
since: 0.1.0
engine: markdown
---


Equivalent to `labs(y: label)`.

## Usage

```typst
ylab(
  label,
)
```


## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` |  | Title drawn beside the y axis. |

## Returns

Dictionary tagged `kind: "labs"`, consumed by [`plot`](../core/plot.qmd).

## Examples

```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/typst-render/ylab-1.svg"
//| width: 10cm
//| height: 6cm
#let d = (
  (x: 1, y: 2),
  (x: 2, y: 4),
  (x: 3, y: 3),
)
#plot(
  data: d,
  mapping: aes(x: "x", y: "y"),
  layers: (geom-point(size: 3pt),),
  labs: ylab("Value"),
)
```

## See also

[`labs`](labs.qmd), [`ggtitle`](ggtitle.qmd), [`xlab`](xlab.qmd).
